name: CRISIL Ltd
about: CRISIL Ltd is a globally diversified analytical Company providing ratings, research, risk and policy advisory services. CRISIL is India’s leading ratings agency and the foremost provider of high-end research to large banks and leading corporations.[1]
keyPoints:
Ratings Business (28% of revenues)[1]
India’s premier ratings agency having rated 35,000+ large and medium-scale entities.[2]
This is the most profitable business of company and accounts for 51% of total profits while contributing only 28% of revenues.[3]
The company separated its credit ratings business into a wholly owned subsidiary, CRISIL Ratings Ltd pursuant to changes in SEBI regulations.[4]

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 30.7%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 60.6%
Debtor days have improved from 79.9 to 61.6 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 11.7 times its book value
